description: Curated view of what an AI generator may reference. NOT the whole token system — a filtered catalog naming every semantic token id an LLM is permitted to cite in a PageSpec's content, plus the closed enum of raw-value categories those ids resolve from.
note: An LLM generating a PageSpec instance never writes a raw hex/px value into content; it references these semantic ids. Section/component contracts under sections/ and components/ resolve them internally.
